The '''S-12 Blackbolt''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] which performed in scout roles. Created at [[Tandankin]] to fulfill the role of reconnaissance, the Blackbolt was equipped with advanced sensor and communications suites. The scout craft had little-to-no armor and was only lightly shielded relying on its swiftness, the power of two laser cannons and a volley of rockets to harass enemy forces.

==Behind the scenes==
The S-12 Blackbolt is one of the four Scout models available to Imperial players in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]'', a [[2013]] Digital Expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Automatically unlocked for players, it is the Imperial faction's offense-recon Scout, with the [[NovaDive]] as the Republic counterpart.<ref name="GS" />
